purpose: Negative controls against inflating specialty coverage with ambiguous employer advertisements

records.title: ENFERMEIRO - BANCO DE TALENTOS
records.reason: Generic talent pool listing describes many medical specialty clinics, not nurse specialty positions in each listed medical service

records.title: TECNICO DE ENFERMAGEM - POLICLINICA
records.reason: Technical nursing role, not a nurse specialist role; list of medical specialties does not substantiate nursing specialization

records.title: Técnico de Enfermagem | Centro de Infusão Ambulatorial
records.reason: Infusion nursing technician under supervision; not evidence of a nurse position mapped to COFEN-I-03

records.title: ENFERMEIRO - CENTRAL DE MATERIAL ESTERILIZADO
records.reason: Title specifies CME but responsibilities largely generic inpatient bedside nursing, urgent care, patient admissions and medication; insufficient to extract CME-specific competencies from this description

records.title: Enfermeiro Assistencial
records.reason: Dermatological or aesthetic procedures appear as desirable prior experience, not a specialist nurse role or credential

candidate_tests: Reject non-nurse job titles from nurse specialty coverage
Do not expand a generic polyclinic job to every listed medical specialty
Do not map desired prior exposure to a specialist credential
Quarantine role-title and job-description domain mismatches
Keep rejected ads out of unique job count and specialty numerator
Retain employer URL and observation date for reproducible review
